text:
Nate (CSM): Orchard Health sent their vendor security questionnaire and flagged a bunch of data flow + KMS questions. Can we pull together answers by EOD tomorrow? They need something for procurement.
Lena (Legal): I can do the DPA/KMS language. Quick Q: do we want to offer both hosted+private options in the form, or just the default hosted answer and an appendix for Private?
Maria (Customer Success): Let's keep main answers focused on hosted (most customers choose that) and have a clear note: private deployment available on request with SOW. That should satisfy procurement faster.
Sam (Eng): For the technical bits: data residency is region-locked (US-EAST by default) and Private can be deployed to their VPC. For KMS: we support customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM integrations. Snippet we can paste into the form: `Data-at-rest: encrypt using AES-256; optional CMK via customer KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault).`
Lena (Legal): Good. For the DPA clause about subprocessors — use our standard list + link to the subprocessor registry. I'll prepare the exact wording.
Julian (Product): Also flag that our Dedicated offering provides SLA-backed throughput — procurement sometimes asks. One-liner: `Dedicated instances (reserved capacity) available with elevated SLAs and physical isolation.`
Maria (Customer Success): I'll assemble answers into the vendor form (spreadsheet) and add an appendix with SOC2 Type II attestation + link to our security page. @evidence-bot can you post the latest SOC2 PDF link? :pray:
evidence-bot: SOC2 Type II report (redacted) uploaded: https://internal.redwood/evidence/soc2-2025-type2.pdf — access requires SSO.
Nate (CSM): Perfect. Plan: Maria to draft form + Lena legal copy, Sam to confirm the KMS text and region lines, Julian to add the Dedicated blurb. Deadline EOD tomorrow. I'll own sending back to Orchard once we have final. :thumbsup:
Maria (Customer Success): On it — I'll add a short cover note for procurement explaining timelines and available options. If legal signs off before EOD we can ship.
Lena (Legal): I'll try to get a sign-off by 3pm. If any item needs redaction we'll flag it in-thread.
Sam (Eng): One small addendum: for export logs question, add: `Audit logs retained for 90 days by default; extended retention available on request (export via API or S3 delivery).`
Nate (CSM): Great. Thanks all — I'll follow up with Orchard once we have the filled spreadsheet.
